name: Smart FD Calculator
author: technicalmohit

sections.description:
Smart FD Calculator is a simple and responsive Fixed Deposit calculator plugin for WordPress.

You can add the calculator to any page or post using the shortcode:

[smartfdcalc]

Features:

  • Fixed Deposit maturity calculator
  • Total interest calculation
  • Shortcode support
  • Responsive design
  • Branding controls
  • Color customization
  • Font family selection
  • Default amount, rate, and tenure controls
  • Lightweight frontend assets
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Smart FD Calculator settings from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure branding, colors, and default values.
  5. Add [smartfdcalc] shortcode to any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I display the calculator?

Use the shortcode [smartfdcalc] on any page or post.

Can I customize colors?

Yes. You can customize primary, background, and text colors from the plugin settings page.

Can I change default FD values?

Yes. You can change the default amount, interest rate, and tenure from the settings page.
